files.name: motion-prompt-017.txt
PROMPT.md
files.content:
Please use "Mask transition" (マスクトランジション), one of the names in "Motion graphics moves".
Motion Prompt #017

What it is: The next scene appears inside a growing shape
What the sample shows: A circle- or star-shaped window grows, showing the next scene inside it.
Spec:
- Day scene → night scene → day scene, 2.35 s each. The change runs at 0.45–1.6 s of each half (1.15 s), cubic ease-in-out.
- The next scene is drawn on top of the current one, clipped to a shape; the shape grows until it covers the frame.
- Day→night: a circle from the sun's centre (112, 104), radius 0→470.
- Night→day: a five-point star from the moon's centre (427, 104), outer radius 0→1150, rotating 1.2 rad (about 69°) as it grows.
- While it grows, the edge of the shape has a white outline (width 7).
When to use it: Use it to change scenes starting from an object in the frame, such as a sun, logo or button.

Reference implementation (Canvas 2D, a function whose picture depends only on the time): https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/en/e/017.txt
Shared helper code: https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/kit/motion.js
Keep the shapes, timing and easing values of the reference implementation as they are, and change only the text, colours and assets to fit what I am making.
